text: あいての　こうげきを　うける　たびに　いかりで　じぶんの　わざの　いりょくが　あがっていく。

structure.jp: あいての　こうげきを　うける　たびに
structure.en: each time it takes the opponent's attack

structure.jp: じぶんの　わざの　いりょくが
structure.en: the power of its own move

patterns.name: 〜たびに
patterns.explanation: たびに after a verb means 'every time that happens'. うける たびに = 'every time it takes (a hit)'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: ていく after a verb says the change keeps going on from now. あがっていく = 'goes on rising'.

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で after a noun here gives the reason something happens. いかりで = 'because of anger'.
